text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Possibility of devaluing Moroccan dirham excluded.
- UNESCO celebration of 90th birthday of former Senegalese president Leopold Sedar Senghor is homage to Africa and its people.
- Appeal court acquits Cameroun national in counterfeit money case.
- Seventeen Moroccan illegal immigrants arrested in Spain.
- Cabinet hears summary of economy from Finance Minister Mohamed Kabbaj - many signs of resumption of economic activity.

- Progress noted in health care in Morocco but deficit in drinking water, level of infant mortality, ratio of doctors to population and level of illiteracy show much still to be done says Moroccan Organisation of Human Rights president
- Meeting of international private sector businessmen to be held in Marrakesh in December.
